entry.title: Berdandy – Glitching Past Red Rock - Single
entry.summary: The best Las Vegas vacation I've had was the one where we left the city, and climbed Red Rock Canyon.

entry.title: Berdandy – String Theory - Single
entry.summary: String theory is a theoretical physics framework where 0-dimensional particles are replaced by 1-dimensional strings. This is not that. But it does have string instruments.

entry.title: Berdandy – Regrets - Single
entry.summary: Melancholy and chill, something for a rainy day in the woods

entry.title: Berdandy – Jet - Single
entry.summary: I've been rewatching a lot of Cowboy Bebop lately. I think that may have filtered through from my subconscious.

entry.title: Berdandy – Souls Beat Slow - Single
entry.summary: When you find your person, the world just melts away, and you move as one.

entry.title: Berdandy – Angry Paintbrush - EP
